segments.ja392:2.1: Na harāmi na bhañjāmi, ārā siṅghāmi vārijaṃ;
segments.ja392:2.3: Atha kena nu vaṇṇena, gandhathenoti vuccati.
segments.ja392:3.3: Evaṃ ākiṇṇakammanto, kasmā eso na vuccati.
segments.ja392:4.3: Tasmiṃ me vacanaṃ natthi, tañcārahāmi vattave.
segments.ja392:6.1: Addhā maṃ yakkha jānāsi, atho maṃ anukampasi;
segments.ja392:6.3: Punapi yakkha vajjāsi, yadā passasi edisaṃ.
segments.ja392:7.1: Neva taṃ upajīvāmi, napi te bhatakāmhase [bhatakamhase (sī. pī.), bhatikamhase (syā.)];
segments.ja392:7.3: Tvameva bhikkhu jāneyya, yena gaccheyya suggatinti.
